messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT PAGE — latency-surge prod cluster eu-west-1 (priority: P1)
pagerduty-bot: Symptoms: elevated p95/p99 for streaming endpoints, user-visible stalls on realtime chat. Automatic paging to oncall.
leo (oncall): I'm up — looking. Seeing alerts for p95 ~600ms (normally ~120ms) and p99 ~1.8s. Streaming stall counts +3.5x.
ashok: (typo, meant ashok) @leo: stack traces show KV cache misses spiking and GPU queue depth rising. Any recent rollouts?
leo (oncall): Checking deployments... aha — autocalib service rolled int8 calibration profiles to 60% of capacity 00:34 UTC.
maria: Confirming correlation in rollout metrics. spike starts ~00:36. Telemetry shows calibration job increased per-token compute for hot paths (extra dequant/pack ops).
chris: Customer impact: a few large customers reported degraded streaming responsiveness. Support tickets created. No total outage but several sessions timed out.
leo (oncall): Initial mitigation plan: 1) Pause autocalib rollout 2) Route traffic away from int8-calib profile to fallback fp16 model in EU region 3) Increase node pool for streaming layer to drain backlog
julie: Running pause now: `POST https://controlplane/api/autocalib/rollouts/stop` -> 202 accepted.
eng-runtime-bot: Rollout stop acknowledged, id=calib-roll-2026-509000.
leo (oncall): Routing rule patch to pin model route to `redwood/gptx-core-fp16-v2` for the streaming route. Applying weighted routing -> set fp16 100% for route `/v1/stream/*` in eu-west-1.
leo (oncall): Patching: ```
curl -X PATCH "https://controlplane/api/routes/streaming" -d '{"default_model":"redwood/gptx-core-fp16-v2","weights":{"redwood/gptx-core-int8-calib":0}}'
```
maria: FP16 switch live. Latency p95 trending down — current p95 180ms (was 600ms). p99 down to 400ms. streaming stalls still trickling but decreasing.
ashok: There's a backlog in the request queue — draining. I increased the streaming pool by 20% to speed drain: `kubectl scale deployment/stream-workers --replicas=48 -n prod`.
chris: Noting customers A and B had sessions with >30s stalls, logged under tickets #5482 #5483. Ops sending customer comms template.
leo (oncall): Can we get an ETA for recovery to normal? Maria?
maria: If drain continues, non-impacted latency expected in ~8–12 minutes. We'll monitor p99 and stall rate.
ashok: Root cause initial hypothesis: int8 calibration path introduced an edge-case dequant scheduling that amplified KV cache thrashing for requests with long context and streaming chunk sizes. This caused GPU scheduling jitter and long tail latency.
chris: We should roll back the calibration artifact (not just stop rollout). What does eng-ml recommend?
julie: Eng-ML (cc @ashok) — recommended rollback plan: revert calibration profile to prior stable checkpoint, disable auto-promote, run targeted calibration against smaller sample sets, then staged canary with synthetic load.
ashok: Agreed. I'll open rollback PR for autocalib: `revert: calib-profile-2026-03-10`. Also toggling safeguard: disable `auto_promote=true` flag.
leo (oncall): Do we need immediate customer-facing mitigation beyond routing? Any SLO credits?
chris: For affected customers, recommend temporary credits + postmortem. Support drafting notice. No SLA breach yet for most, but some will hit p99 SLO for streaming — we should track windows per tenant.
maria: Observability notes: saved traces to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/5090001234/traces.zip and added Grafana snapshot https://grafana.redwood.internal/s/incidents/5090001234.
leo (oncall): Eng-runtime, can we get a hotpatch to avoid the expensive dequant path being scheduled synchronously? Maybe unroll to async dequant for long contexts.
ashok: quick patch idea: change `dequantize_sync=true` -> `false` for hot path. I'll test locally on canary nodes.
eng-runtime-bot: Canary deploy started: runtime-patch-509000-canary -> 5% traffic on eu-west-1 (non-production test cluster).
julie: While that tests, let's proceed with rollback so we avoid more customer impact. I'm going to coordinate rollback and change freeze on autocalib.
leo (oncall): Rollback PR merged and applied at 00:49 UTC. Autocalib profiles reverted to previous stable.
maria: Confirming metrics after rollback+routing+scale: p95 now ~130ms, p99 ~220ms, streaming stall rate down to baseline +5%.
chris: Marking incident as mitigated in pagerduty. Need SRE follow-up for permanent fix.
leo (oncall): Handoff notes for next oncall and eng teams: 1) Autocalib auto-promote disabled 2) Rollback applied and recorded 3) FP16 routing used as fallback and reverted once stable 4) Runtime patch concept in review (asynchronous dequant) 5) Customer tickets updated and communications sent.
ashok: Postmortem tasks: - run focused benchmarks for int8 calib workloads with long-context streaming - add telemetry to detect KV cache churn early - add canary traffic limit for autocalib.
julie: I'll open a postmortem doc and assign owners: Eng-ML (ashok), Eng-Runtime (maria), SRE (leo), Support (chris).
leo (oncall): Final checks: any remaining elevated errors or backlog?
maria: backlog drained, no elevated error rates. We'll keep watch for 2 hours.
chris: Closing pagerduty incident; follow-ups scheduled. Thanks all. :clap:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED — status: mitigated, incident_id=PD-509000-LL
